verdicts.tldr: Handshake reads ResponseInfo without checking its Error, so an app refusing Info still completes the handshake; no in-tree app sets that field
verdicts.details: replay.go:239-243 checks only the Go error from InfoSync. A handshake against an app whose Info returns ResponseBase.Error completes with a nil error. No non-test Info implementation sets the field (BaseApp, kvstore, persistent_kvstore, counter, BaseApplication), so nothing reaches it today, and it predates the branch. Ships SKIP: no issue, for the same reason as round 3 row 1003.
verdicts.evidence: go test -overlay with tests/parent-5-info-error-ignored_test.go ./tm2/pkg/bft/consensus -run TestZZInfoErrorIgnored -v: 'handshake err=<nil>', --- PASS
verdicts.verify_by: an app whose Info returns Error, run through NewHandshaker(...).Handshake
